messages.snippet: Dear colleague, The firm's document management system (Whitfield DMS) will be upgraded this Saturday
messages.subject: [Action required] Document management system upgrade - Saturday 8 February
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleague,

The firm's document management system (Whitfield DMS) will be upgraded this Saturday 8 February between 07:00 and 14:00. During this window the DMS and document check-in/out will be unavailable. Please check in any documents you are working on before Friday 18:00.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
